oracle: every credential of the address an account moved from is refused after the move (A1.10)
what: the move leaves personal tokens minted under the old address unrevoked, so one still acts as that address

target.case: A1.10 an account Google renamed moves to the new address: "moving", the job done, the new address reads its shares and manages its documents, and the old address's cookie and token are refused

expect.message: a personal token minted under the old address still works after the move
